steps.name: Epilogue ~ Bait
steps.objective: Listen to the two men's conversation in a quiet spot in 「Deborah Snowfield」, then press the Complete Quest button.

lines.text: (In a quiet corner of Deborah Snowfield, two men in conspicuously unsuitable clothes brush the snow from themselves.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: What a nuisance...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: There seems to be no trace of the serpent left on this continent. To think our encounter with Lethe was the last...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The serpent is crafty. It must have crawled into hiding somewhere.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Why are you laughing?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I was just wondering.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: How you felt, watching that child's beginning, end, and new beginning...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The child who became master of this world...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: As the blood of the Tyr people created by Goddess Seres grew thin, their descendants lived as ordinary humans.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Awakenings were rare, but we still hunted down and killed those with Tyr blood, didn't we?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That reminds me of someone else. Hehe. Following a mage around with a smile, unaware of being a god...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: In any case, you're still denying what you are. The state you're in now is all because...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: One more word, and I'll...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Why can't you understand that you can't?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Ghh... Urrgh! Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Cough, cough...
(After a prolonged coughing fit, Kazno loses consciousness and collapses into the snow.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Foolish Kazno...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You could live if you stopped everything you're doing for that child. What does that child mean to you, that you would endure even death?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Suggesting we hunt the serpent, dragging that meddling witch out of hiding, revealing that one to be a being like us... All of it...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Everything you did for that child, Kazno...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And how long have you been here?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Huh...?
(While supporting Kazno, Jeril catches a girl's eye. As he smiles at her, she steps back in confusion.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (Eyes of different colors... That armor... I feel I've seen her somewhere...)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: No need to be afraid. Just tell me who you are and where you came from.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Why am I here? Who are you people?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I hid so well even Weiss couldn't find me. How did you do it?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Wait, why am I in Eastland? I was in Glaston a moment ago...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Weiss? Staying on the run from the sinner is no small feat. Yet you don't seem to be an Agasura...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: You're comparing me to an Agasura? Please don't. Honestly... I thought things would be easier once this land had a new god...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Let's not meet again, wolf boy. No, old man.
(The girl glances around and hurries away along the snowy path.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Dismissed just like that... I don't like showing off my Agasura nature, but I suppose I have no choice.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Allow me to give you a gift.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Stop.
(Jeril's low murmur reaches the girl's ears. For an instant, she feels her body seize up, but she merely smiles.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: You're an Agasura? I don't want to get involved, so let's leave it at that.
(The girl stretches with ease, and Jeril gives a wry smile.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hah. Interesting. That was no trifling spell, yet you broke it and moved. You're quite something. In that case...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: No. I'll let you go. If that's what you are, we're bound to meet again.
(Before Jeril can say another word, the girl vanishes into the distant blizzard. He stands there and begins laughing wildly.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hahaha... Hahaha, hahahahaha!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Ngh... What is it?
(Kazno regains consciousness and looks up at Jeril, who meets his eyes with a brilliant smile.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Rejoice, Kazno. We've found bait for Ouroboros to swallow.
